# PR #4476: Patch: a Spell's effects on every card and its random picks pass a Unit Immune to Spells by, as its aimed ones already do, and Meteor's spill skips a Dormant neighbour

Closes #4453

## What changed

A Spell now passes a field Unit with Immune to Spells by however its text reaches it, as §6.1 says ("Spells can't target it or affect it"). Before, this only held when the Spell aimed at the Unit or named it through a board scope. Meteor's leftover damage also now skips a sleeping (Dormant) card beside its target.

**Engine changes.** Each change asks the existing `restrictions::unaffected_by`; no new state, statics or numbers.
- `effects/card_scope.rs`, `cards_in_card_scope`: in a Spell's walk, a field card marks as unmatched (the same pattern as R940's check). It is not dropped, so a verb that has to cue a whole hidden pile still cues it whole (R440). Copies in hands and decks are still reached.
- `effects/buff.rs`, `buff_all_units`, and `effects/position.rs`, `switch_all_positions`: skip an immune Unit.
- `effects/radiant.rs`, `field_cards_of`: the field pool behind `set_radiant_random` and `radiant_chance` leaves the immune Unit out.
- `effects/plague.rs`, `ask_placement`: takes `from_spell`, and the placement pool leaves an immune Unit out when a Spell runs it. The random branch now reuses that list instead of reading the board a second time.
- `damage.rs`, `adjacent_units_of`: a Dormant neighbour is no longer a neighbour, so Meteor's excess goes on to the other neighbour and, on the Radiant face, to the hero.
- The header and the `unaffected_by` docs in `restrictions.rs` now list these walks.

**Cards that play differently.** C+ #50 Adaptive Growth, M+ #1.4 Leg Day, Core #62 Friend of Felinors (Radiant face), Core #48 5pek Controller, M #34 高考's Buff, S+ #32 Z-Patch, S+ #20 B-Patch, C+ #40 Appropriations (Military, Healthcare, Culture), C+ #77 Anti-Softlock, S+ #103 Transcend, the Tears of the Kwzki Tree token's end-of-turn Buff, Core #28 Knockoff Temu Glowy Jelly Bean, C #70 Book of Plague's random placement, and S #3 Meteor. **Spec.**
- New ruling `spec/rulings/R4453000.md`, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/4453.md`.
- §6.1's Immune to Spells and Dormant rows, one clause added to R1848001, and an R4453000 clause in each affected card's §8 row (§8.2, 8.3, 8.6, 8.7, 8.8, 8.9, 8.10, 8.12).

## Tests

Twenty-four new tests, all named `r4453000_…`:
- **Engine rules (11):**
  - `effects_card_scope.rs`: a Spell's scope against a Unit's scope; hand and deck copies still reached; a hidden card kept in a whole-pile walk; `buff_all_units` from a Spell, a Unit and a Field Trap; `switch_all_positions`.
  - `effects_plague_random_cast.rs`: random placement; nothing to place; the chosen prompt; a Unit's placement still offers the immune Unit.
  - `spell_verbs.rs`: Meteor beside a Dormant neighbour, both faces.
- **Card scripts (13):** Adaptive Growth, 5pek Controller, 高考, Z-Patch, Transcend, Appropriations (Military and Culture), Knockoff (×2), Book of Plague (×2), Meteor (×2).

I checked that the tests depend on the change by reverting only the engine sources and rerunning them:
- 19 of the 23 tests I could check failed without the change.
- 3 are controls that should pass either way (a Unit's scope, a Unit's or Field Trap's buff, a Unit's placement).
- Book of Plague's chosen-prompt card test also passed without the change (see below).

I did not run `cargo jackioh carried`.

## Decisions the issue did not settle

- **No patch fragment.** The issue asked for one, but stage 2 replayed the play code against main's build and no game diverged: these only matter when an immune Unit or a Dormant neighbour is on the board.
  - A `--plays` or `--rule` claim would fail `classify --claims`, which runs on the pull request as `rust (classify)`; a fragment that claims nothing fails `patches check`.
  - So this ships with no player note. Rejected: claiming the cards anyway, which turns CI red.

# #4453: Patch: a Spell's effects on every card and its random picks pass a Unit Immune to Spells by, as its aimed ones already do, and Meteor's spill skips a Dormant neighbour
Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot.

## What it actually means
Some Units are immune to Spells: the rules say no Spell may aim at them or change them. Today that holds only when a Spell aims at one. A Spell that changes every Unit, or picks cards at random, still reaches the immune Unit. Adaptive Growth gives every Unit −2/−2, and an immune Paragon-X shrinks with the rest. 高考 shows the gap inside one card: its destroy half spares an immune card, and its Buff half, in the same Spell, upgrades it. Once this is built, a Spell passes an immune Unit by whatever its wording, so a player who builds around immunity gets what the card promises. While at it, Meteor's spilled damage stops vanishing into a sleeping (Dormant) card beside its target and goes on to the live Unit on the other side.

## Why
- SPEC §6.1, Immune to Spells: "Spells can't target it or affect it … every Spell's effect list skip[s] it". R1185002: "a Spell's set passes a Unit Immune to Spells by, as every scope does". R781001 (superseded on Immutable only): "Immune to Spells stops every effect of a Spell, aimed or not".
- The aimed path asks `restrictions::unaffected_by` (`effects/targets.rs`: `resolve_target`, `instance_on_its_stay`, `matches_scope`), so a target and a `cards_in_scope` walk are right. These walks never ask it:
  - `cards_in_card_scope`'s field walk (`crates/engine/src/effects/card_scope.rs:147-165`) drops Dormant cards and nothing else (R940's tribal immunity aside), so a Spell's `buff_cards`, `grant_keyword_cards`, scoped `upgrade`/`degrade` (`tune.rs:1034`) and `transform_cost_step` (`transform.rs:548`) reach an immune Unit;
  - `buff_all_units` (`buff.rs:146`) and `switch_all_positions` (`position.rs:69`) walk `active_units_of` and call `apply_buff` and `switch_position`, which do not ask;
  - `set_radiant_random`'s field pool (`radiant.rs:111`) and Book of Plague's random placement (`effects/plague.rs:208`, in a random cast or under a Mayor) draw from `reachable_permanents_on_field`, which drops only Dormant cards (R4322000).
- Spells that reach an immune Unit today: C+ #50 Adaptive Growth, M+ #1.4 Leg Day, Core #62 Friend of Felinors (Radiant), Core #48 5pek Controller, S+ #32 Z-Patch, S+ #20 B-Patch, M #34 高考 (its Buff), C+ #77 Anti-Softlock, C+ #40 Appropriations (Military), S+ #103 Transcend, Core #28 Knockoff Temu Glowy Jelly Bean and C #70 Book of Plague (random placement). Eleven cards and seven tokens carry Immune to Spells (`spec/CARDS.md`, Keywords: S #74 Paragon-X, S #116 Megabase, S+ #67 Phase Wall, S+ #110 to #114, S+ #160 Icarus …), so it comes up in real games. No test covers any of these walks against an immune Unit; 高考's covers only its destroy half (`c034_gaokao.rs:212`).
- S #3 Meteor: `adjacent_units_of` (`crates/engine/src/damage.rs:934`) leaves out a neighbour a Spell cannot reach but keeps a Dormant one. A Dormant neighbour is in the coin flip, `land` refuses it (`acts_on_field`) with `held: 0`, and the excess stops there: the other neighbour, and the Radiant face's hero, get nothing. R1848001 spills onto the Units acting beside the target.

## Proposal
1. `cards_in_card_scope`'s field walk asks `restrictions::unaffected_by(ctx, card)`, so every verb on a card scope passes an immune field Unit by when the running effect is a Spell. Hands and decks are untouched (immunity protects only on the field, R940), and Field Spells, Traps and Units still reach it.
2. `buff_all_units` and `switch_all_positions` skip a Unit `unaffected_by` names.
3. `set_radiant_random`'s field pool and Book of Plague's random placement leave out a Unit a Spell cannot reach, so the draw lands where it can change something, as R4322000 did for Dormant cards.
4. `adjacent_units_of` leaves out a Dormant neighbour, so Meteor's excess goes on.
5. A ruling in the issue's block naming the verbs and cards, its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/<issue>.md`, and a pending patch fragment with its player note (`cargo jackioh patches … --rule`).

Arcane Missiles stays with #4424. Evasive is out of scope: it bars aim, and scopes and random picks still reach it by design (`restrictions.rs` header).

## Where it lands
- `crates/engine/src/effects/card_scope.rs`, `effects/buff.rs`, `effects/position.rs`, `effects/radiant.rs`, `effects/plague.rs`, `damage.rs`, and the header list of `restrictions.rs`
- rules tests in `crates/engine/tests/rules/` on fixture scripts, one per verb
- the tests of the card scripts above: at least Adaptive Growth, 5pek Controller, 高考, Z-Patch, Knockoff Temu Glowy Jelly Bean, Book of Plague and Meteor
- `spec/rulings/R<issue>000.md`, `spec/pending/<issue>.md`, `crates/cards/patches/pending/`
- SPEC §6.1 (Immune to Spells, Dormant); R940, R1185002, R1848001, R4322000

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Adaptive Growth's −2/−2 leaves an enemy Unit with Immune to Spells as it was and shrinks the others; an every-Unit buff from a Unit or a Field Spell still reaches it.
- [ ] 5pek Controller leaves an immune Unit in its position.
- [ ] 高考's Buff passes an immune CN or KY permanent by, as its destroy already does.
- [ ] A Spell's scoped `upgrade`, `buff_cards`, `grant_keyword_cards` and `transform_cost_step` skip an immune field Unit, and the same scope still reaches an immune card's copy in a hand or a deck.
- [ ] Knockoff Temu Glowy Jelly Bean never draws an immune field Unit; with only immune Units on the field it draws among the hand and the library.
- [ ] Book of Plague's random placement never lands on an immune Unit, and places nothing when no other permanent stands.
- [ ] Meteor beside a Dormant card and a live Unit sends its excess to the live Unit (and the Radiant face's hero) whichever way the coin lands.
- [ ] The ruling's note, a test named after it, `cargo jackioh spec check` and `cargo jackioh classify --base origin/main --claims` are green.
- [ ] `cargo test -p jackioh-engine --features testkit --test 'rules*'`, `cargo test -p jackioh-cards`, `cargo jackioh golden check` and `cargo jackioh fuzz --seeds 200` are green.

## Size and risks
Hard: engine rules across six verbs, about 15 to 20 files, mostly tests. Risks:
- The rule makes no difference between harm and help, so Leg Day's and Appropriations' buffs skip the caster's own immune Unit too. If the designer wants helpful Spells to reach it, the ruling records that as a spec change instead.
- The change is in engine verbs, not in one card's script, so `KEPT_SCRIPTS` does not cover it. The build runs `cargo jackioh golden check` and `cargo jackioh carried` and says how an older replay that played one of these Spells against an immune Unit is treated. #4357 made the same kind of engine change for Dormant cards.
- The AI plays through the engine, so its reads follow without changes.
